qa.recommendation: GEM shows 83.3 MW per unit. The EIA-860M table for September 2026 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia860m/xls/september_generator2026.xlsx) lists plant 69147 generators G1 to G6 at 84.0 MW nameplate each and 81.0 MW summer. The Mississippi air construction permit 1680-00090 (https://opcgis.deq.state.ms.us/ensearchonline/get_doc.aspx?dt=finalp&id=1783643) lists each GE 7E turbine at 90 MW. TVA says the plant adds about 500 MW. I suggest 84 MW per unit from EIA, but a reviewer should choose.
qa.note: Three sources disagree slightly, so I did not change the value.

qa.recommendation: The construction step has no date in the database. The air construction permit was issued May 12, 2025 (https://opcgis.deq.state.ms.us/ensearchonline/get_doc.aspx?dt=finalp&id=1783643).
